purpose: Define one pure, deterministic rule that resolves the eligible instant observations of one record type so that equal-time observations neither bias a Health Summary nor are destructively merged: every observation falls in exactly one resolution; observations whose instants and values are exactly equal form a reversible Duplicate Group that contributes once and keeps every member; observations at one instant with different values form an unresolved tie that contributes nothing and breaks no tie; and the result is recomputed from the eligible set alone, so correction, retraction, exclusion, or deletion changes it without any retained state.

inputs.name: eligible_observations
inputs.description: The instant observations a derive unit would otherwise count, after it has applied the Source Selection Policy and any Amendments and dropped records without a Canonical Revision: for each, its Source Record identity and position within the record, its source-system kind and origin, its exact instant as integer nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, and its value in the record type's canonical unit as a Python int or finite float. Heart Rate samples and Weight measurements are observations; Steps intervals and Sleep sessions are not.

outputs.name: contributions
outputs.description: One contribution per resolved instant, ordered by instant: the shared instant and value and the sorted members. A contribution with one member is a single observation; one with two or more members is a Duplicate Group, which contributes exactly once, has no representative member, and states its rule and its exact confidence.

outputs.name: unresolved_ties
outputs.description: One unresolved tie per instant whose observations carry two or more different values, ordered by instant: the instant and the observations partitioned by value. No observation of a tie contributes, and no value is chosen.

outputs.name: record_facts
outputs.description: The sorted Source Record identities with an observation in a Duplicate Group and those with an observation in an unresolved tie, which a derive unit uses to choose summary-contract@1 standings and to report the duplicate-grouped and equal-time-conflict evidence conditions.

outputs.name: duplicate_observation_failure
outputs.description: A named failure raised instead of a result, carrying only its name: no instant, value, origin, Source Identity, or record identity.

owns: what counts as an instant observation for duplicate handling, and its identity within a Source Record
exact equality of instants and of values, with no tolerance, rounding, or unit conversion
the partition of eligible observations into single contributions, Duplicate Groups, and unresolved ties
Duplicate Group membership, identity, order, rule, and confidence, and the rule that a group contributes once
the rule that a tied observation never contributes and no tie-break is applied
determinism and reversibility: the result is a pure function of the eligible set, independent of input order
which failure and representation content is free of health values, origins, and identities
does_not_own: which records are eligible: applying Source Selection Policies and Amendments and reading evidence is the derive units' and the store's
extracting observations from Canonical Revision bodies or headers, and local-date attribution; the derive units and processors do
evidence standings, primary states, the evidence-condition vocabulary, and summary bytes; summary-contract@1 owns them and each derive unit chooses standings
any sum, count, mean, minimum, maximum, latest point, or other statistic computed from contributions
Steps interval overlap and Sleep stage overlap rules
Source Conflict, which concerns one Source Record's own unordered projections
detecting evidence changes and scheduling recomputation; refresh-summary-state and the store do
storing groups or ties, and how they are rendered
